name: Winter Walker Spells
description:
When you reach a Ranger level specified in the Winter Walker Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

Level 3: Ice Knife

Level 5: Hold Person

Level 9: Remove Curse

Level 13: Ice Storm

Level 17: Cone of Cold
